items.comments: The owner is very nice and friendly. the house very clean I like here

Gayne is probably one of the best host. She is very helpful with everything so you can feel comfortable. She always asked me if I needed a lift and even dropped me downtown on my first day in Seattle!
The room is cosy and as described, the house is pretty well-furnished so you will not miss anything.
The neighborhood is quiet, really close to Green Lake and only 15/20 min away from downtown by bus (which stops very close to the house).
Do not hesitate and say hello when you see her!
